tool_args.rationale: The open-branch observations establish gradient dependence, but all seven rows share the same horizon and initial context. A fine trajectory is needed to distinguish plausible coupled dynamics and identify their parameters before forecasting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a static gradient-dependent saturating law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The seven observations do not identify the time evolution or distinguish a static response from a coupled flux-conserving mechanism.

considered_alternatives.option: Beverton–Holt recruitment or bilinear mass action
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed gradient dependence contradicts the stated gradient-independent recruitment law, while the pilot is not linear in u_now.
It does not resolve the mechanism or forecast-horizon ambiguity.
